entities.summary: Mandy Haase is a field hockey defender from Germany, who won the gold medal with the German national team at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, Greece. She made her debut for the national squad on 18 May 2003 with a victory in a friendly match against the Czech Republic (3–0).
